99	    // server logger: writes to local file; replace with console-only CF shim.

107	  // Inject a banner that polyfills Node.js globals missing from CF Workers nodejs_compat.
108	  // Must run before any module initialization (pino uses process.hrtime.bigint at load time).
109	  banner: {
110	    js: [
111	      "// CF Workers polyfills for missing nodejs_compat APIs",
112	      "if (typeof process !== 'undefined' && !process.hrtime) {",
113	      "  process.hrtime = function(time) {",
114	      "    const ms = Date.now();",
115	      "    const s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);",
116	      "    const ns = (ms % 1000) * 1000000;",
117	      "    if (time) return [s - time[0], ns - time[1]];",
118	      "    return [s, ns];",
119	      "  };",
120	      "  process.hrtime.bigint = function() { return BigInt(Date.now()) * 1000000n; };",
121	      "}",
122	    ].join("\n"),
123	  },
124	  splitting: false,
125	  define: {
126	    "process.env.NODE_ENV": '"production"',
127	    // db/src/client.ts uses import.meta.url to locate migration files.
128	    // In CF Workers this code path is never exercised (migrations run externally),
129	    // but the variable is assigned at module level so we need a valid URL base.
130	    "import.meta.url": '"file:///worker.js"',
131	  },
132	  logLevel: "info",
133	});
